format: All Competition OS events, audit of ballot retrievals
requirement: DanceFlow policy: every authorized ballot content retrieval or derivation writes an append-only ledger row (actor, event, scope, timestamp, purpose, channel, ballot references) in the same transaction as the read; ballot contents are never copied into audit records.
interpretation_notes: Owner decision OD-10 requirement 5. The ledger cannot cover postgres/superuser, dashboard SQL, backups or replicas, nor callers refused at EXECUTE. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-10 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Options A + C with audit logging; retrospective audit PR #795)
